guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during the step installing Miniconda with the error: "The command '/bin/bash -c wget --quiet https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py39_23.7.2-1-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /tmp/miniconda.sh && bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p /opt/miniconda3 && rm /tmp/miniconda.sh' returned a non-zero code: 8". This non-zero exit code typically means a fetch or installer failure possibly caused by network issues or the installer script being corrupted or unavailable at that URL. To fix, verify the URL is correct and accessible from the docker build environment. You may try adding debug flags (e.g., removing --quiet) to wget to get more detailed error logs, or downloading the installer outside the RUN command to test manually. Additionally, ensure that wget is properly installed before this step (which it is here). Finally, consider updating the Miniconda installer version or switching to an official conda base image to avoid manual installation errors.
